title: Galileo Project monthly meetings

tellings.quote: I'm on the Galileo team since the first week. I every Monday, the first Monday, the first Friday of every month, we meet on Zoom. I never miss a meeting.

plain: The Galileo Project, a scientific search for signs of alien technology led by the researcher Avi Loeb, holds team meetings on Zoom early each month, and the well-known skeptic Michael Shermer says he has been on that team since its first week and never misses one. Shermer tells it himself, to show that he takes part in the search even while doubting the claims.
